title: Ali's Day
text:
Ali is a student. Every morning he gets up at seven. He brushes his teeth and eats bread with cheese. Then he walks to school with his friend.

At school, Ali reads books and writes notes in his notebook. At lunch, he eats an apple. After school, he plays basketball in the yard. In the evening, he watches TV and sleeps early.

questions.text: What does Ali do every morning?
options: He goes to bed at midnight

questions.text: What does Ali eat at lunch?
What kind of person is Ali probably?
Why does Ali probably sleep early?
options: He is tired after a busy day
He wants to watch more TV

paragraph_translations: Ali bir öğrenci. Her sabah saat yedide kalkar. Dişlerini fırçalar ve peynirli ekmek yer. Sonra arkadaşıyla birlikte okula yürür.
Okulda Ali kitap okur ve defterine notlar yazar. Öğle yemeğinde bir elma yer. Okuldan sonra bahçede basketbol oynar. Akşam televizyon izler ve erken uyur.
